Such a wonderful experience the girls that work there and Michelle were absolutely wonderful to us we are loyal to this place from now on such a great experience I can't say it enough and my dog loves them

I own a Pomeranian and I brought him here as a puppy months ago. I had to bring him back for a second brushing because they were not finished with him after hrs at his first appointment and then they suggested cutting his hair super short. Additionally, at his second visit he contracted worms. The lady suggesting to cut him short was rude about my dog and dismissive instead of taking care. I now take him to mobile 1 on 1 groomers and never had any issues.

I took a client's dog there to do some training. It was his first groom and the attendants were so nice. They checked on him and pet him to help him feel more comfortable. They had treats so I could treat the process. It was great.

I am this upset I am writing a 2nd review. My dog did not get a cut for which I paid a total of $190 (outrageous price point) for. 2 weeks later and his fur is getting dark because they didn’t cut it shorter around his feet. Same way the private areas weren’t cut. They only framed a tiny bit the tail and the face, but his eyes were not freed from hair nothing. I find it very upsetting that none of these were mentioned to me. I already had to return as I noticed his nails were not trimmed. But how much do you want to traumatise your dog when you know they dislike the groomer. Wow. Def mot worth your money or the 4.7 star reviews!!

Thank you so much for taking the time to leave us a perfect 5-star review! We are thrilled to hear that you had a great experience with our pet grooming services at Bowie Barker West Hollywood. If there's anything more we can do for you or your pet, please don't hesitate to let us know. We look forward to welcoming you back soon!

Why is it so darn impossible to make an appointment, I pay a monthly membership but there is NEVER availability and I have to pay for appointments elsewhere what is the point. And what is worse Booking on the APP is infuriating, there is no option for "next available appointment" I am forced to slog through 3 daily time options which are booked usually one two or three weeks out. I tell the staff who are all angels weekly to fix their useless app but nothing changes. Wake up Bowie Barker this is exhausting to get service with the membership when oh when are you going to fix your terrible scheduling app before clients go balístic?!!!! I'd be happy to post this every day until you mar being a member user friendly. Thank you for your continued ignoring of this matter. Plz reach out and offer me a time to get an appointment I pay for monthly!!!!!!!!!!!!
